title: Evolutio is one of the six Spanish-capital integrators and otherwise unresolved
content:
Evolutio is named among the six Spanish-capital integrators, and the record says nothing else. That membership is a real and checkable fact — the Spanish market has few domestically owned integrators of scale, and being one of them means technology direction is set in-market rather than by a foreign parent.

Beyond that, stack, size and open-source posture were all unresearched. The lead sits at priority 4 needing an OSS screen, and this note exists to record that the only thing currently qualifying it is the ownership category.
